/custom-plastic-cups/:
How do I choose plastic cups with lids and straws?

Use the exact model and component references. Nominal capacity alone does not establish lid or straw fit. Confirm the chosen components and packing in the specification.
/custom-silicone-cups/:
Which reference can I use for silicone shot glasses?

LJB-001 is the silicone shot-cup reference in the current model library. Review its model page, then confirm the final dimensions, logo and quantities for your project.
/led-light-up-cups/:
Can LED cups with logo share the same power and lighting?

No common configuration is assumed. State the desired lighting, activation and power preference, then review each selected model. The logo should be checked with the light on and off.
/bar-accessories/:
Are silicone sleeves, neoprene sleeves and foam can coolers interchangeable?

No. They are different material or construction references. Match the intended can, bottle or glass, then confirm the material and decoration for the specific model.
